DAC7 SELLER REPORTING CHECKER · RUNS IN YOUR BROWSER · NOTHING UPLOADED

Will the platform report you to the tax authority?

Enter what you did on one platform this calendar year. You get a reported / not reported reading, your headroom under the goods exemption, what the platform sends and the tax number deadline.

A first read written from the Directive without a live lookup. Member States transpose it differently; the result names the source to verify. It is not legal or tax advice.

Fill in the figures, then click Check my reporting.

Result


    

    
 

  


  

    
What it does, and what it leaves to you

    
    
      
  • Covers: the EU DAC7 platform reporting of goods sales, personal services, property rentals and transport rentals.
    • 
      
  • Gives: reported or not, the reason, headroom under the goods exemption, what is sent, the 31 January report and the 60-day tax number rule.
    • 
      
  • Not decided: whether your income is taxable, national differences in what counts as consideration (fees, refunds), hotel and large-listing exclusions for operators, non-EU rules such as the UK's, and any change after this page was written.
    • 
    

    
If you sell on US platforms too, see the 1099-K threshold checker. Selling on Etsy? Try the Etsy profit calculator.

  


  

    
Common questions

    
What is DAC7?

    
DAC7 is the EU directive (2021/514) that makes online platforms collect seller details and report each seller's earnings to the tax authority every year, starting with 2023. The platform sends the report by 31 January and gives the seller a copy.

    
What is the DAC7 threshold for selling goods?

    
A seller of goods is not reported if, on that platform in the calendar year, they made fewer than 30 sales and received no more than EUR 2,000. Crossing either limit makes the whole year reportable.

    
Do services and rentals have a threshold?

    
No. Personal services, renting out property and renting out transport have no de minimis exemption, so even a single transaction can be reported.

    
Does being reported mean I owe tax?

    
No. The report only tells the tax authority what you earned through the platform. Whether the income is taxable is decided by your national tax rules.

    
What happens if I do not give the platform my tax number?

    
After two reminders the platform must close your account or withhold payments, about 60 days after its first request.

    
Is my data uploaded anywhere?

    
No. Everything is calculated in your browser and nothing is sent; a test in the code asserts there are no network calls.
